items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: Flip Phillips was in the band before I joined actually... And a lot of them went on to be really jazz players too, like Flip Phillips.

ctx.x: That’s interesting because after the big band era the singers really became more popular but you managed to just play the gig instrumentally.

Yup, yeah. I wanted to mention you know that Flip Phillips was in the band before I joined actually. So I mean he carried a lot of weight. That was the jazz band you know. That was considered the jazz band of that era.
